issues.title: Gamma misconfigured: 0.0909 instead of 0.5
issues.description: The Adam-phase gamma was set via gamma_ratio=0.1 giving gamma=0.0909 (9% PDE, 91% data weight). The reference implementation uses gamma=0.5 (50/50 PDE/data). With only 9% PDE weight, the network overfits noisy u/h data during Adam instead of learning physics, causing B to drift. Fixed by setting gamma=0.5 throughout all phases, matching the reference. This also eliminated the need for the separate gamma_lbfgs parameter.

issues.title: Missing Adam+fixed-collocation transition phase
issues.description: The original 2-phase training (Adam+resampling -> overlap-LBFGS) jumped directly from stochastic resampling to L-BFGS. The reference implementation uses 3 phases: Adam+resampling -> Adam+fixed -> L-BFGS. Added the intermediate Adam+fixed-collocation phase (7500 budget) to stabilize the loss landscape before L-BFGS. This gives the model a smooth optimization trajectory entering the L-BFGS phase.

issues.title: Budget allocation suboptimal
issues.description: Original used 15000 Adam + 35000 overlap-LBFGS. Adjusted to 20000 Adam+resampling + 7500 Adam+fixed + 22500 overlap-LBFGS to match the reference's proportional allocation pattern (50%/25%/25% Adam-resample/Adam-fixed/L-BFGS).

summary: Fixed gamma from 0.0909 to 0.5 (matching reference) and added 3-phase training (Adam+resampling -> Adam+fixed -> overlap-LBFGS). Mean B_err improved from 1.21e-3 to 8.06e-4 (33.6% reduction), now beating both the Adam-only baseline (8.63e-4, 6.6% better) and the original overlap-LBFGS. Seed 1 improved from 6.26e-4 to 2.54e-4; seed 2 from 1.60e-3 to 7.57e-4. The gamma fix was the critical change: with proper PDE/data weight balance, the network learns physics structure during Adam, providing a much better starting point for subsequent phases.
